title: Pairing-Swap Interaction Diagnostic, corrected domain
kind: inference-only; two-stage gated; no training; no p-value; no EPE/D1/RMSE

design_authority.note: this record designs nothing. Every geometric bound below is copied from the two records named here, which were written and frozen before this experiment was authorised.
design_authority.predecessor_status: HALTED AT HS1 -- INVALID DOMAIN -- NO-ADMISSIBLE-RESULT

geometry.sign: right[y,x] = left[y,x+t] => d = x_L - x_R = +t px

extractor.structure: 4 x Conv2d(k=5,s=2,p=2), 6 x ResBlock(k=3,p=1), 1 x Conv2d(k=3,s=1,p=1)
extractor.halo_adopted_rationale: symmetric conservative bound; the adopted band is a strict subset of the measured band
extractor.status: SOURCE + DERIVED + MEASURED (216/216 records, domain audit)

domain_chain.cost_volume_binding_constraint: Lf[w+k] clean for ALL k <= 11 => w <= 55 - 11 = 44; stricter than 55 - tau for every tau <= 6, so the domain is TAU-INDEPENDENT
domain_chain.why_not_translation_band_as_mask: it is wrong twice: TOO WIDE (ignores the k<=11 reach and the 5-cell aggregation radius) and TAU-DEPENDENT (a support shrinking with tau confounds the across-tau comparison)
domain_chain.status: DERIVED, each step measured in the domain audit

mask.row_bound_status: INHERITED conservatism, not derived. The derivation permits all 17 feature rows for the horizontal arm; the inherited border only removes support and can never admit an invalid location. Widening it after the GEOM-001 halt would be support-shopping and is NOT done.
mask.halo_invariance_measured: injecting two different arbitrary halos leaves the statistic on this mask bit-identical 24/24, max |difference| exactly 0.0 (domain audit S6). Under the GEOM-001 mask the argmin flipped in 8 of 24.

effective_support.note: the 44352 pixels are a bilinear upsampling of 20 columns x 11 rows of feature grid; the pixel count overstates independence by roughly 16^2

scenes.selection_rule: INHERITED verbatim from GEOM-001; twelve lowest previously-unused indices ascending, paired consecutively

pairing_invariant: each source frame occurs exactly once as a left image and exactly once as a right image; the same tau in all four cells

statistic.profile: Ibar_tau(k) = median over the 44352 masked pixels of I_tau(k,.,.)
statistic.k_hat: argmin_k Ibar_tau(k), smallest index on an exact tie
statistic.h: sum over tau in {1..6} of hit, so 0 <= h <= 6
statistic.I_second: min over k != k_hat of Ibar_tau(k)
statistic.margin: I_second - I_min, DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, appears in no verdict rule
statistic.status: INHERITED verbatim from GEOM-001 spec.json; nothing added, nothing removed

readout.pipeline: aggregate -> bilinear upsample (17,71)->(272,1136) align_corners=True -> per-pixel z-score across k -> softmax(-z) -> soft-argmin
readout.instrumentation: regression.capture stores the exact tensor the softmax consumes; it changes no arithmetic

aggregation.own_padding: needs no exclusion -- it is part of the LINEAR operator, applied identically to all four cells, so it lives in the channel the 2x2 interaction cancels exactly (design audit S4: affine arm <= 2.3e-06 relative, nonlinear arm 0.71-0.86)

random_gate.question: can the architecture / a random aggregation alone produce argmin-at-tau tracking under this exact statistic?
random_gate.population: 3 extractors x 6 pairs x 32 seeds = 576 units
random_gate.H_star: max(h) over all 576 units, REGENERATED in this record
random_gate.old_numbers_void_reason: every prior gate figure was computed on the invalid GEOM-001 mask or on synthetic fields
random_gate.rule: G-STOP if H* == 6 -> terminal STATISTIC-ARCHITECTURALLY-AVAILABLE, trained weights never loaded; else H* := max(h_rand), unaltered
random_gate.trained_aggregation_destroyed_at_load: model.aggregation = None immediately after the checkpoint load, before any forward pass

trained_arm.per_checkpoint_reporting: the six-value vector of per-pair h, never pooled
trained_arm.case_C: if some checkpoints exceed H* and others do not -> CASE C HETEROGENEOUS; report every checkpoint separately; do not pool

vertical_control.rescue_requirement: FH >= 31 cells = 496 px, exceeding the KITTI frame height of 368 px
vertical_control.structural_reason: the crop is 71 cells wide but only 17 tall against a 15-cell halo: 71-30 = 41 > 0 but 17-30 < 0
vertical_control.never: used as the primary statistic; compared to H*; entered into h_trained
vertical_control.stage: Stage 2 only; the gate does not run it

NEG_shift_none.what_it_would_have_been: a search-free control: a shift='none' checkpoint whose twelve disparity slices are provably identical (EXP-010), so no candidate-coordinate information exists
NEG_shift_none.why_excluded: the authorisation says 'Load exactly these frozen H2 checkpoints: H2 seed0, H2 seed1, H2 seed2' and 'No checkpoint selection'
NEG_shift_none.cost: this record carries ONE null -- the random-aggregation gate -- and no architecture-level null. A real reduction in discriminating power, declared, not discovered afterwards.

HS1.A: pixel construction exact, asserted element-wise from the actual arrays; both arms
HS1.B: Rf[w] == Lf[w+tau] EXACTLY (tolerance 0) on w in [15, 55-tau]; horizontal only
HS1.C: max |V[:, tau, :, w]| == 0.0 EXACTLY for AA and BB on w in [15, 45); horizontal only
HS1.D: statistic domain non-empty, tau-independent, at least D = 12 columns wide; static
HS1.vertical: B and C are INAPPLICABLE and are recorded as such, never as passes -- no halo-clean vertical band exists
HS1.changed_from_geom001: the band starts at w = 15, not w = 0; GEOM-001's HS1 spanned the 15-cell left halo and fired on the first volume constructed

hard_stops.HS2: AA/BB/AB/BA construction incorrect (each frame exactly once as left and once as right)
hard_stops.HS3: tau differs across the four cells
hard_stops.HS5: checkpoint sha256, num_disparities, shift, aggregation parameter count or readout parameter count differ from the frozen specification
hard_stops.HS6: process-restart determinism fails (bit comparison of the designated unit)
hard_stops.HS7: a trained aggregation is loaded before G-PASS; enforced by two processes plus destruction of the aggregation at load in stage 1
hard_stops.HS8: any historical record modified; verified before AND after every stage
hard_stops.HS10: any response contains NaN or Inf
hard_stops.HS11: optimizer, backward, parameter update, or refinement invoked
hard_stops.policy: any hard stop RAISES and the process exits non-zero; nothing is repaired and continued

interaction_validity.scope: UNCONDITIONAL -- pointwise, content-independent, valid inside the halo and inside the zero-fill region
interaction_validity.anchor: the prediction 'the minimum sits at k = tau' exists ONLY where V(tau) = 0, i.e. only on the clean domain. THIS is what needed the mask.
interaction_validity.the_conflation_that_killed_geom001: 'main effects cancel' is true and was used to justify ignoring the halo. But the halo does not introduce a main effect -- it DESTROYS THE TREATMENT in the positive cells. Cancellation cannot manufacture an anchor that is not there.
interaction_validity.after_the_z_score: NO CLAIM. The z-score is nonlinear and is part of the measured statistic; the random gate is what calibrates it.

determinism.restart_test: stage w4 recomputes one designated trained unit in a fresh process and compares the Ibar bit patterns

changes_from_geom001.change: HS1 split into HS1-A/B/C/D on their correct domains
HS1-B / HS1-C tolerance fixed at exactly zero
vertical arm reclassified as a contaminated null / downgrade trigger only (retained, not removed)
random-gate H* regenerated rather than inherited

changes_from_geom001.class: SCOPE REDUCTION imposed by the authorisation; declared cost in controls_not_run

scientific_design_changes_proposed: NONE beyond item 7, which is a removal imposed by the authorisation
unchanged: interaction statistic I_tau(k), the median reduction, and argmin_k == tau
h = sum over tau of hit

claim_ceiling.if_trained_exceeds_the_gate: Under the specified synthetic horizontal pairing intervention, the trained nonlinear aggregation-plus-readout response tracks the known geometric pairing displacement more strongly than the preregistered random-aggregation population.
claim_ceiling.if_it_does_not: TRUE CORRESPONDENCE -- NOT DEMONSTRATED. This is NOT evidence that correspondence is absent.
claim_ceiling.independence: three checkpoints from one training recipe are irreducibly reused, and the designer has read eight prior response curves. Consistency evidence at best.

unresolved_questions: whether ~220 feature cells of support yield a stable argmin -- UNKNOWN until Stage 1 runs; it is what the gate measures
why the right halo is 14 cells and the left 15 -- UNKNOWN, stride/padding parity likely, not load-bearing
whether a learned non-correspondence shortcut could place its minimum at k = tau -- UNKNOWN, not addressable by any ablation of this architecture
what the statistic does under a provably search-free architecture -- NOT MEASURED in this record (see controls_not_run)
